info.name: Onboarding Client G - E2E Scenarios
info.description: Pruebas de onboarding, content-service y MinIO. Ejecute cada carpeta en orden. Para el upload seleccione manualmente un PDF en el campo file.

exec: pm.test('Onboarding is UP', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('UP'); });
pm.test('Content service is UP', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('UP'); });
pm.test('MinIO is live', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Case starts at product selection', () => {
pm.response.to.have.status(201); const body = pm.response.json();
pm.expect(body.currentStep).to.eql('product-selection'); pm.expect(body.version).to.eql(0);
pm.collectionVariables.set('successCaseId', body.id);

pm.test('Products are persisted', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.currentStep).to.eql('terms-and-conditions'); pm.expect(b.data.productSelection.productIds).to.have.length(2); });
pm.test('Terms are accepted', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.currentStep).to.eql('personal-data'); pm.expect(b.data.consent.accepted).to.be.true; });

pm.test('Personal data is persisted', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.currentStep).to.eql('kyc'); pm.expect(b.data.applicant.firstName).to.eql('Alexis'); });

pm.test('KYC data is persisted', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.currentStep).to.eql('address'); pm.expect(b.data.kyc.documentType).to.eql('PASSPORT'); });

pm.test('File set is created', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.caseId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('successCaseId')); pm.collectionVariables.set('successFileSetId', b.id); });

request.description: Antes de enviar, seleccione un PDF local en Body > form-data > file. Onboarding delega el binario a content-service/MinIO y registra el metadato local.

exec: pm.test('Document is stored and available', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('AVAILABLE'); pm.expect(b.objectKey).to.match(/^content-service:/); pm.collectionVariables.set('successDocumentId', b.id); });

pm.test('Stored document can be downloaded', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('application/pdf'); pm.expect(pm.response.stream.length).to.be.above(0); });

pm.test('Address is persisted', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.currentStep).to.eql('contact-verification'); pm.expect(b.data.address.city).to.eql('San Salvador'); });

pm.test('Contact is persisted', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.currentStep).to.eql('identity-verification'); pm.expect(b.data.contactVerification.email).to.eql('alexis@example.test'); });

pm.test('Dummy biometric provider verifies identity', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.currentStep).to.eql('enrollment'); pm.expect(b.data.identityVerification.provider).to.eql('dummy'); pm.expect(b.data.identityVerification.status).to.eql('VERIFIED'); });

pm.test('Enrollment is persisted', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.currentStep).to.eql('contract-acceptance'); pm.expect(b.data.enrollment.accountType).to.eql('CHECKING'); });

pm.test('Onboarding completes at version 9', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('COMPLETED'); pm.expect(b.currentStep).to.eql('completed'); pm.expect(b.version).to.eql(9); pm.expect(Object.keys(b.data)).to.have.length(10); });

pm.test('Every workflow step has an audit event', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const events=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(events).to.have.length(10); pm.expect(events[0].eventType).to.eql('CASE_STARTED'); pm.expect(events[9].resultingStep).to.eql('completed'); });

pm.test('Terms and contract consents are stored', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const c=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(c).to.have.length(2); pm.expect(c.every(x => x.accepted === true)).to.be.true; });

pm.test('Invalid scenario starts normally', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('invalidCaseId', b.id); pm.expect(b.currentStep).to.eql('product-selection'); });
pm.test('Incomplete data returns 400', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.include('productIds'); });
pm.test('Skipped step returns 409', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(409); pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.include('not allowed'); });

pm.test('Invalid requests do not advance the case', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.currentStep).to.eql('product-selection'); pm.expect(b.version).to.eql(0); pm.expect(b.data).to.eql({}); });

pm.test('Rejected operations create no action event', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const e=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(e).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(e[0].eventType).to.eql('CASE_STARTED'); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('foreignCaseId', pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}'));

pm.test('Original case is created', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('originalCaseId', b.id); pm.expect(b.id).to.not.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('foreignCaseId')); });
pm.test('Unknown case ID returns 404', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));

item.name: 03.03 Verify original case was not modified

exec: pm.test('Original flow remains unchanged', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.currentStep).to.eql('product-selection'); pm.expect(b.version).to.eql(0); pm.expect(b.data).to.eql({}); });

pm.test('Foreign ID creates no event on original case', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const e=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(e).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(e[0].eventType).to.eql('CASE_STARTED'); });
